hook: A robot brain trained only in simulation

beats.say: SenseTime released SenseNova RoboRSI 27B, a robot agent model, with open weights under Apache 2.0.
With no real robot data in embodied post training, the same weights ran on two physical arms, and stacked blocks on a Piper X in nine of ten trials.
It chooses between a vision language action policy and writing code, rejects bad trajectories and replans. SenseTime reports a RoboDojo score of 34.7 against 27.6 for GPT-6 Astra.
